audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart gives Vex all seven rows and grades the lane HARD 8/10, while content win[] and packet.levelChart both read Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Ekko/Ekko/Ekko and every content sentence says Ekko pulls ahead from 6.
audit.why: 51.27% over 1061 games is an even lane, not an 8/10. Doom 'n Gloom genuinely taxes Ekko's E early, which is why 1-5 is even rather than Ekko's; but Vex has no dash of her own outside a 140s Shadow Surge, so once Chronobreak exists Ekko dives a target that cannot reposition.
audit.corrected: Full phases[0..6].side set to Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Ekko/Ekko/Ekko with ratings rebalanced and whys rewritten in the same group; diff HARD -> EVEN, diffRating 8/10 -> 5.5/10, tone to amber, and both difficulty prose lines matched.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 swing was described without the number that causes it.
audit.why: Shadow Surge is 140/120/100 against Chronobreak's 110/80/50. At rank 1 Ekko's insurance returns 30 seconds sooner than her only repositioning tool, which is exactly why 6 is the flip point.
audit.corrected: Stated the 140s vs 110s comparison in phases[4].why and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions were understated: Doom 'n Gloom does not merely fear — it INTERRUPTS dashes and marks any nearby enemy who dashes, and Personal Space is a shield that absorbs the burst window.
audit.why: Riot's passive text: 'causing her next basic Ability to fear enemies and interrupt dashes. Whenever a nearby enemy dashes, Vex applies a mark that can be consumed for bonus damage that also reduces the cooldown of her empowered state.' Ekko's E is his only gap-closer and only exit, so every use both risks interruption and accelerates her next empowerment. Personal Space is 16s at rank 1 falling to 12s and must be forced out before committing (missingInteractions shield-absorbs-burst).
audit.corrected: Stated the dash interrupt and the mark feedback loop in enemyWin, breakdown.cooldowns, phases[1].why, breakdown.feeding and dontsFull[2].d; the shield in phases[2].why and dosFull[1].d.

audit.why: It is the field that carries real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Personal Space 16s->12s, Mistral Bolt 8s->4s, Shadow Surge 140s, Chronobreak 110s.
